limitations: The second retained table shares the first table ancestry and cannot independently validate placements.
Switches 43 and 44 use the script-bound slingshot wall centroid as a playfield mechanism projection; the exact mechanical switch itself is not modeled.

Solenoids 1-5,8-10,17-18 project the effect onto the script-bound corresponding mechanism, not the physical coil. Solenoids 3 and 4 use the midpoint of their respective pairs of reset targets. Solenoids 9 and 10 project the relay-controlled magnetic effect and do not locate the relay coil.
Solenoid 11 switches backbox/cabinet GI according to preliminary manual PDF16; the table callback drives a playfield GI proxy, which cannot establish physical playfield emitters.
Switches 10,12-14 are not independently modeled by ball-stack proxies.

Lamp insert centers are manually projected measurements, not physical sockets; no placement is marked validated. Lamp 59 is partly hidden; 30 differs from the VPX visual proxy by about 0.043 normalized.
The factory lamp drawing and table proxy swap physical sides of lamps 42-47. The matrix labels and magnet award probes establish the corrected physical side and order.

Output 7 has one measured physical symbol and another leader to a plastic outline. Output 19 leaders end on outlines. Output 13 has two playfield-head lamps in PDF41 but no two individually located sockets and additional backbox lamps of unresolved count. Unmodeled GI emitters remain unplaced.
